turns.text: Hello, this is Anaya from U GRO Capital. Am I speaking with the owner of the business, or someone who handles the business finances? Just so you know, I'm an AI assistant, not a human agent. This call is recorded for quality and training purposes. I'm calling about your business loan enquiry. Is this a good time to take two or three minutes? I just need a few details about your business to check what you'd be eligible for.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: What's the name of your business?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: It's Sharada Textiles, proprietorship, textile trading, running about 6 years.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Roughly what was your turnover in the last financial year?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Around 72 lakhs turnover last year, and I need maybe 15 lakh for working capital.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Based on what you've told me, this looks like it fits our criteria, so I'll pass it to a credit officer for an in-principle review. Your business structure is eligible for our unsecured business loan. Before I arrange that, is there anything you want to ask me?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Are there any hidden charges I should know about?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: There are no hidden charges – you’ll see processing fees, bounce charges, penal charges on overdue instalments and foreclosure charges listed in our schedule of charges, and I can send you that schedule.
